chapter.title: Grey Harvest
chapter.tagline: When the sky turns grey, a face in a mask forces a forgotten hero to choose.
chapter.summary: Chog #1463 awakens in Lantern Row, discovers the Sky Gardens’ harvest has turned grey, and confronts a masked thief wearing its own face. After a water‑aura showdown, the hero obtains a torn map of the Monad Spire, but the thief threatens to burn the city unless the hero surrenders. Now, with Pip in tow and the city on edge, the hero must decide whether to chase, protect, or bargain.

panels.scene: Cold cobblestones, flickering neon rain above, the hero awakens alone
panels.action: Hero blinks, confusion painted across face, palms pressed against stone
panels.caption: The city whispers…

panels.scene: A holo‑news drone hovers, projecting a grim skyline
panels.action: Drone beams message: "Sky Gardens’ harvest turned grey overnight!"
panels.caption: Sky Gardens mourn.

panels.scene: Mira the noodle‑shop owner shouts as the hero’s duplicate darts away
panels.action: Masked hero snatches glowing grain, mask rattles, Mira screams
panels.caption: Run!

panels.scene: Hero unleashes Aqua Aura, water slashes the mask off
panels.action: Water jets forward, mask cracks, revealing gaunt stranger with scarred eye
panels.caption: Who are you?

panels.scene: Stranger drops torn map, Gilded Forks enforcer raises blaster
panels.action: Map falls, enforcer points weapon, eyes flicker
panels.caption: What is this?

bubbles.speaker: hero
bubbles.text: A map to the Monad Spire?

panels.scene: Hero chases through neon‑lit stalls, dodging Gilded Forks patrol
panels.action: Hero leaps, stalls sway, map clutched in paws
panels.caption: No stopping me!

panels.scene: Pip the orphan Chog clings to hero, begging for safety
panels.action: Pip clutches hero’s leg, eyes wide, hero looks concerned
panels.caption: Help me!

panels.scene: Masked thief reappears, pulse‑blaster raised, demanding map
panels.action: Thief points blaster, eyes glint, voice echoing
panels.caption: Choose!

cover.scene: Neon‑flooded Lantern Row alley, rain misting, a lone figure awakes
cover.action: Hero opens eyes, heart racing, the world dissolving into neon haze

choice.prompt: What should the hero do now?

options.label: Give chase: pursue the masked impostor into the Underbazaar and try to retrieve the map.
Protect Pip: flee to the Sky Gardens to investigate the grey harvest and keep the child safe.
Trade the map: hand it over to a Gilded Forks officer for immediate protection and resources.

role.title: Hungry Wanderer of the Neon Docks

chapter.title: Soup & Shadows
chapter.tagline: A bowl of soup, a flash of fire, and a challenge that could scorch the city.
chapter.summary: Chog #1464 is thrust into a duel after a soup triggers a memory of a destroyed garden. The fight leads to a sealed crate that bursts, coating his iconic cap with a mysterious crimson powder. Now the hero must decide how to handle the powder—each choice could reshape his fate and the city’s rebellion.

cast.name: Chog #1463
cast.role: Bloodied Avenger of the Grey Famine

panels.scene: Rusted barrels and flickering neon signs cast pink and blue light on the wet docks.
panels.action: Masked Chef Saffron thrusts a steaming bowl toward the hero, who cradles it, eyes locked on the crowd watching the red cap.
panels.caption: The neon docks never sleep, but they hold their breath tonight.

bubbles.speaker: Masked Chef Saffron
bubbles.text: Eat. Last time you were this hungry, you burned down the Sky Gardens.

panels.scene: A ripple of steam rises from the bowl, blurring the background into a wash of orange and black.
panels.action: The hero’s eye dilates as the broth touches his lip; a jagged overlay of flames erupts from the steam, Saffron's mask looming distorted.
panels.caption: Memory is a fire that never truly cools.

bubbles.speaker: hero
bubbles.text: I remember the smoke. I remember the heat.

panels.scene: The crowd parts as a massive silhouette steps forward, holding a sealed crate stamped with the hero's token.
panels.action: Chog #1463, the rival, points a heavy finger at the hero, while Saffron slides a crumpled map across the barrel. The hero flips his cap.
panels.caption: Duel declared. Map offered. The exit is closing.

bubbles.speaker: Chog #1463
bubbles.text: One-on-one, Wanderer. The crate holds your token. Meet me in the dark.

panels.scene: Gold-clad Gilded Forks form a blockade at the dock exit, their armor reflecting the neon signs.
panels.action: The hero flashes his retro glasses with a blinding white light, creating a silhouette gap. He darts into the shadowed alley, map in hand.
panels.caption: Light is a shield if you know how to bend it.

panels.scene: A vast, dark pit surrounded by betting crowds and hanging lanterns that sway in the draft.
panels.action: The hero stands before the sealed crate, eyes wide. Chog #1463 circles him, drawing a hidden blade from his sleeve.
panels.caption: The Underbazaar keeps its secrets in the dust.

bubbles.speaker: Chog #1463
bubbles.text: Your token, or your cap? Choose.

panels.scene: Sparks fly from the pit floor as the hero spins, a red blur against the grey stone.
panels.action: The hero executes a 'Peaceful Spin', striking the rival mid-lunge. The impact sends the rival staggering back, the blade clattering to the ground.
panels.caption: Peace is just violence with better manners.

panels.scene: The sealed crate bursts open, releasing a swirling cloud of crimson mist that clings to the hero's red cap.
panels.action: The hero’s cap absorbs the mist, glowing faintly. A shadowy figure in the crowd steps forward, hands raised.
panels.caption: The powder doesn't burn. It remembers.

bubbles.speaker: hero
bubbles.text: What is this? The cap... it's humming.

panels.scene: The crimson mist swirls around the hero's face, the glow intensifying within the red cap.
panels.action: The hero freezes, eyes darting to the shadows where a cloaked figure has appeared, pointing a finger at the glowing cap.
panels.caption: The prophecy was never a story. It was a countdown.

bubbles.speaker: Cloaked Figure
bubbles.text: Finally, the cap of the prophesied Chog...

cover.scene: The Underbazaar pit, bathed in crimson mist.
cover.action: The hero spins his red cap, eyes wide as the powder coats his clothes, the rival lunging with a hidden blade.

choice.prompt: The crimson mist spreads over the hero’s peace cap. How do you act?

options.label: Let the powder settle and continue fighting, risking unknown powers
Toss the powder into the crowd to create chaos and possibly stop the duel
Throw the crate into the pit, causing an explosion that could end the fight for all

chapter.nextTime: The powder spreads—will the hero become a weapon, a savior, or a target?

chapter.title: First Light
chapter.tagline: A missing mayor, a stolen shoe, and a face that belongs to a criminal.
chapter.summary: The nameless Chog awakens in Lantern Row with a mayoral shoe and a masked thief mirroring its face. A chase through the Neon Docks ends in fire, an explosion, and the arrival of Pip, the tiny orphan. The hidden emblem on the shoe points to the Council of Blocks, leaving the hero with a crucial decision.

panels.scene: Narrow alley, neon flickers, crowd shouting
panels.action: Hero wakes, slaps shoe onto paw, looks startled
panels.caption: What happened to me?

panels.scene: Masked figure slips through crowd
panels.action: Hero watches, eyes widen, hand clenched
panels.caption: That mask... looks like me!

bubbles.speaker: Masked Chef Saffron
bubbles.text: I am no one but you!

panels.scene: Hero chases mask toward Neon Docks
panels.action: Hero dashes, sneakers squeak, mask slips ahead
panels.caption: I have to catch you!

panels.scene: Hero reaches docks, enforcers block path
panels.action: Hero faces Captain Brine, demands shoe
panels.caption: Show me that shoe!

bubbles.speaker: Captain Brine
bubbles.text: You have a crime to pay!

panels.scene: Hero darts between crates, Red Spin Dash
panels.action: Hero spins, rolls over stack, grain scatters
panels.caption: Red Spin Dash!

panels.scene: Explosion of spices
panels.action: Crate explodes, flames lick sky, masked thief flees
panels.caption: BAM!

panels.scene: Pip appears, pulls hero
panels.action: Pip tugs hero sleeve, offers help
panels.caption: We must go!

panels.scene: Hero examines shoe
panels.action: Hero sees hidden emblem of Council of Blocks
panels.caption: The shoe holds a secret…

cover.scene: Lantern Row alley, neon glow, city hum
cover.action: Hero stands, one shoe heavy on paw, looking up at buzzing crowd

choice.prompt: Holding the mayor's lone shoe, the hero must decide the next move. What do they do?

options.label: Follow the shoe to the Neon Docks to investigate the shipment hub.
Return to Lantern Row and ask the locals for info, risking exposure to the masked criminal.
Take the shoe to the Underbazaar, hoping Doctor Umami can analyze it, but risk illegal dealings.

role.title: Bloodied Avenger on the Edge of Destiny

chapter.title: Seeds of Defiance
chapter.tagline: When the pulse of fate beats faster than a heart, a choice can shatter a city.
chapter.summary: The Avenger faces a three‑way split as Baron's enforcers tempt with food, Vex steals the key, and the Iron Arena’s tournament looms. A duel with rival Chog #1464 erupts, forcing the hero to confront Saffron’s bargain and the forged prophecy. With a ticking timer, the hero must choose between embracing a cursed seed, destroying the spire’s conduit, or rescuing Pip.

panels.scene: Wind howls across the Monad Spire balcony. Rain slicks the metal floor.
panels.action: The hero stands frozen, hand shaking over a glowing green seed shard. Pip clings to the hero's arm, looking up with worry. Saffron’s shadow looms behind.
panels.caption: The seed pulses. The choice hangs in the cold air.

bubbles.speaker: Saffron
bubbles.text: Do you know what you're sacrificing?

bubbles.speaker: hero
bubbles.text: I don't want to leave Pip behind.

panels.scene: Golden light cuts through the grey rain. A plate of shimmering food hovers nearby.
panels.action: Captain Brine extends a silver plate of golden rations. The hero's stomach growls loudly, eyes wide with renewed, desperate hunger.
panels.caption: Hunger spikes to 100%. Willpower crumbles.

bubbles.speaker: Captain Brine
bubbles.text: Eat, and you obey. Simple math, hero.

panels.scene: The balcony railing cracks as Old Crate rams into it.
panels.action: Old Crate lunges forward, grabbing the hero's shoulder and dragging them toward a hidden maintenance tunnel. Debris flies. The hero's posture twists in pain.

bubbles.speaker: Old Crate
bubbles.text: No time for rations! Move, move, move!

panels.scene: Instant transport to the Iron Arena. Holo-screens flash red and blue.
panels.action: Aqua Aura erupts from the hero, shattering hovering drones. The arena gates begin to open. The rival, Chog #1464, bursts in on a rusted gauntlet.

bubbles.speaker: cast
bubbles.text: Duel me for the key! No tricks!

panels.scene: Water torrents clash in the center of the arena. Sparks fly from the impact.
panels.action: The hero unleashes 'Mon Hoodie Ripple,' a massive wave of water cutting through the rival's guard. Pip, caught in the splash, spills and the scarf catches fire.

panels.scene: The smoke clears. Saffron steps into the center ring, holding a second shard.
panels.action: Saffron holds up a second, darker seed shard. Her eyes glitter with hidden intent. The hero pauses mid-recovery, wary.

bubbles.speaker: Saffron
bubbles.text: Trade your pulse for the key. Easy.

panels.scene: A digital timer on the arena floor counts down: 10... 9...
panels.action: The hero hovers their hand over the glowing green shard. Vex’s voice crackles over the comm. The air vibrates with tension.
panels.caption: Three years of training. One shot.

panels.scene: The green shard glows blindingly bright. The timer hits 3...
panels.action: The hero's eyes widen in horror. Saffron smiles. The ground begins to crack. The decision is made—too late.
panels.caption: Saffron’s 'shard' is forged. The key is a lie.

cover.scene: The Monad Spire balcony at twilight.
cover.action: The hero grips a glowing green seed shard, face strained, looking down at the chaos below.

consequences.text: starving hero recruited by Baron's enforcers with a promise of food → Gilded Forks appear offering a golden ration, pulling the hero toward obedience
filthy, smelly hero turned away from the Iron Arena entrance → forced to fight outside the arena, under the ticking timer
keeper’s indecision let Vex snatch the rusted key → pulse intensifies, Pip’s scarf soaked in blood, and the conduit erupts

choice.prompt: With the arena timer ticking, the seed shard pulsing, and Vex’s ultimatum, what will you do?

options.label: Grab the glowing seed shard now, risking its curse
Destroy the conduit, halting the pulse but losing the seed
Lead Pip to safety and abandon the fight, trusting Vex to handle the spire

chapter.nextTime: Next time: The arena gates slam shut, and a familiar silhouette steps onto the battlefield, eyes fixed on Pip.

role.title: Accidental Champion turned Reluctant Riot King

chapter.title: Riot Crown
chapter.tagline: When the crowd crowns you, the city's fate follows.
chapter.summary: The hero wins an unremembered arena fight, only to be hailed by a chanting crowd that names him. A duel with the feared avenger #1463 erupts amid a city‑wide riot, and the hero snatches a makeshift crown that ties him to an empty council seat. Now, with The Hollow watching and Pip at his side, he must decide whether to lead, flee, or settle the challenge.

cast.name: Chog #1463
cast.role: Bloodied Avenger of the Grey Famine

panels.scene: Steel doors seal the arena, dust thick in the air.
panels.action: The hero raises a shattered gauntlet, blood streaked, looking up at the roaring crowd holding a broken helmet.
panels.caption: The crowd chants a name no one remembers choosing.

bubbles.speaker: narrator
bubbles.text: Chog 1464! The name echoes, unknown yet undeniable.

panels.scene: View through open walls to Lantern Row, torch light flaring.
panels.action: A masked figure on the balcony hurls a torch; lanterns ignite in a line of fire outside.
panels.caption: Vex’s spark catches the wind, and the city burns.

bubbles.speaker: Vex Gang Member
bubbles.text: Light it up! Let them see the true color of this court!

panels.scene: Arena entrance, chaos spilling in, sparks flying.
panels.action: The rival steps in, brandishing a scarred sword, pointing it at the hero with a snarl.
panels.caption: Order dissolves into riot; the Avenger arrives to end the farce.

bubbles.speaker: Chog #1463
bubbles.text: Your reign ends now, 1464! Step aside or fall!

panels.scene: Close on the hero's face, glass eyes reflecting orange light.
panels.action: The hero’s retro glass eyes flash, blinding the rival, while Pip darts past shouting the chant.
panels.caption: Blindness is a shield when you know the name.

bubbles.speaker: Pip
bubbles.text: CHOG 1464! CHOG 1464! THEY HEAR US, VEX!

panels.scene: Top of the Spire ledge, shadows deep, crossbow aimed down.
panels.action: The Hollow aims a silent crossbow directly at the hero's chest, bowstring taut.
panels.caption: Above the noise, silence waits. One shot changes everything.

panels.scene: Arena floor, twisted metal crown lying amidst debris.
panels.action: The hero grabs the makeshift crown, realizing its weight and the empty seat it represents.
panels.caption: This isn't just metal. It's the vacant seat on the Council.

bubbles.speaker: hero
bubbles.text: So that’s what the crowd is calling for. A king.

panels.scene: Rust Quarter streets, explosion debris flying toward the arena.
panels.action: A barrel explodes in the distance; debris arcs toward the arena walls, forcing the hero to shield the crowd.
panels.caption: Vex strikes. The choice is yours: protect the people or the prize.

bubbles.speaker: Vex Gang Member
bubbles.text: DETONATE! SEND IT! BREAK THE ARENA!

panels.scene: Arena exit, dust heavy, arrow streaking through air.
panels.action: The rival’s sword lands a crushing blow on the hero’s shoulder; The Hollow’s arrow clips the crown and the hero’s hat.
panels.caption: The crown flies. The name remains. Who truly speaks for the city?

bubbles.speaker: Chog #1463
bubbles.text: Too late, 1464. The throne is mine!

cover.scene: Iron Arena floor, debris scattered, smoke rising.
cover.action: The hero stands defiantly, one grey eye glowing, holding a twisted metal crown high above the chaos.

choice.prompt: As the chaos swells, what will you do?

options.label: Lead the crowd against the Baron's forces, using the crown as a rallying symbol
Escape the arena and hide, preserving yourself for later
Challenge #1463 to a duel to settle the chant and the crown

chapter.nextTime: Next time: The Hollow's arrow finds its mark, and Pip discovers a hidden map inside the crown.

role.title: Relentless Pursuer, seed‑bearer on the run

chapter.title: Chasing Shadows
chapter.tagline: A seed of power, a city in pursuit.
chapter.summary: The Chog pursues Goldblade but collapses from starvation, waking in a stranger’s attic. A standoff erupts as the seed’s sigil lights up, revealing its true nature and drawing a timer. Now, factions close in and the hero must choose how to wield the prophetic fragment.

panels.scene: Neon haze cracks as seed light explodes
panels.action: Goldblade fires blaster; seed glow shatters; hero staggers, Aqua Aura flickering
panels.caption: A sudden burst of energy.

panels.scene: Slick dock floor turns into a void
panels.action: Hero drops, legs give out, Aura flickers, vision fades to black
panels.caption: The ground swallowed him.

panels.scene: Dim attic lit by flickering bulb, dust motes swirl
panels.action: Hero sits, Old Crate offers cot, wary smile, shadows play
panels.caption: A refuge in darkness.

panels.scene: Hero's hoodie creaks, Pip holds tight, eyes wide
panels.action: Pip shakes, clings to hoodie, whispers urgently

panels.scene: Alley opens, Goldblade bursts in, demands seed
panels.action: Goldblade demands seed, Old Crate pulls hidden pistol, blasters crackle
panels.caption: Tension crackles.

panels.scene: Cargo container explodes, grey fog spirals, air thickens
panels.action: Explosion ruptures container, fog swirls, obscuring all, choking breath
panels.caption: Smoke and chaos collide.

panels.scene: Seed cracks, ancient sigil glows, prophecy's eye appears
panels.action: Seed splits, sigil projects, city’s watchful eye manifests
panels.caption: The sigil sings the past.

panels.scene: Goldblade lunges, hero's Aqua Aura surges, striking him
panels.action: Hero's Aqua Aura surges, hits Goldblade, Old Crate shouts defiance
panels.caption: Timer ticks.

bubbles.speaker: Goldblade
bubbles.text: You were never meant to hold that, little one.

cover.scene: Neon skyline, hero stands atop dock, seed glowing
cover.action: Hero holds seed aloft, light radiating, ready to run

consequences.text: Pursuing Goldblade → immediate chase, injury, and forced refuge in a stranger’s attic
Starved yesterday → collapse on the dock, awakening in Old Crate’s home

choice.prompt: With the seed pulsing and the timer ticking, what will you do?

options.label: Hand the seed to Goldblade and bargain for safe passage
Hide the seed and seek allies in the Underbazaar
Activate the sigil to open a hidden conduit in the Monad Spire

chapter.nextTime: Next time: The ticking seed forces a desperate race to the Sky Gardens before the grey famine engulfs everything.
